name: carbon-footprint-platform
description: A personalized carbon footprint awareness platform: understand, track, and reduce your environmental impact.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
